tha-ap448:1.1: Ambāṭakiya.] Supupphitaṃ sālavanam ogayha Vessabhū muni / nisīdi giriduggesu abhijāto va kesarī. // //
tha-ap448:2.1: Pasannacitto sumano ambāṭakam apūjayiṃ / puññakkhettaṃ mahāvīraṃ pasanno sehi pāṇihi. // //
tha-ap448:3.1: Ekatiṃse ito kappe yaṃ puppham abhiropayiṃ / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi Buddhapūjāy' idaṃ phalaṃ.
tha-ap448:7.1: Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Ambāṭakiyo thero i. g. a-ti.
